AI-powered video editor that turns raw footage and a creative brief into

sampled_core_commit.message:
fix(video): stop keys typed into the console window from cutting the video short or stalling the clip join

The FFmpeg that joins the clips of every video ran without -nostdin, so
it read keys from the console it inherits: the webui.bat window, or the
console of main.py or cli.py. A "q" typed there stops the join with exit
code 0, and the task finishes with a video whose footage ends at that
point, followed by a black frame with subtitles for the rest of the
narration. A "c" opens FFmpeg's "Enter command" prompt, and the join
then waits for Enter until ffmpeg_concat_timeout_seconds (3600 s by
default) fails the task. On Windows, a key typed into the window while
nothing reads it, even before the task starts, waits there and is read
when the join starts.

The other FFmpeg commands in app/ that process media (voice.py, bgm.py,
material_upload.py, sonilo.py, elevenlabs_music.py, video_project.py)
already pass -nostdin, and MoviePy starts its FFmpeg processes with
stdin set to DEVNULL or a pipe.
